title: 北京でドローンの販売、持ち込み禁止の新規定施行　テロ対策など「首都の安全」を優先
extracted_text: 【北京＝三塚聖平】北京市で今月、ドローン（無人機）の販売や持ち込みを市内全域で全面的に禁止する新たな規定が施行され、中国メディアは「北京が中国で初めてドローンの販売を禁止した都市になった」と伝えた。中国政府はドローンを新興産業として後押ししてきたが、ウクライナなどの戦闘で兵器として多用されていることを受け、テロ対策を念頭に「首都の安全」を優先した結果とみられる。
translated_text: [Beijing = Sepei Mitsutsuka] A new regulation banning the sale and bringing of drones (unmanned aircraft) into the city has been implemented in Beijing this month. Chinese media reported that "Beijing has become the first city in China to ban the sale of drones." The Chinese government had been supporting drones as a new growth industry, but given that they have been widely used as weapons in battles such as in Ukraine, it appears that the priority has been placed on "the safety of the capital" with counter-terrorism measures in mind.
title_en: New regulation banning drone sales and brings into Beijing takes effect | Counter-terrorism measures prioritize 'safety of the capital'
